title: One ring: I've reached. Two rings: call me back.

caption:
One ring, I've reached. Two rings, call me back. Every Indian family ran on this code in 2006, and nobody paid for the call.

She's wearing two. Brushed satin huggie earrings, about 12mm across, chunky without the weight. Brushed Gold Huggies, ₹999.

Today's mangal: Bengali, মঙ্গল.

[ brushed gold huggies · 18k gold tone plated · no balance required ]
alt_text: Short video on a deep plum ground: a drawn sage keypad phone from the 2000s shows 2 missed calls on its small screen. Beside it, two real brushed gold-tone huggie earrings. Text: House rule 07, circa 2006. One ring: I've reached. Two rings: call me back. In the video the phone rings twice and one huggie appears with each ring, then the two come together as one pair of earrings, shown with its size and price, 999 rupees, and the line: she's wearing two, call her back. The Naira wordmark and the word Mangal, also in Bengali, sit at the bottom beside a small steel key.
posting_notes: Upload cover.jpg as the custom cover; keep 'also share to feed' on.

reel.mp4 carries a near-silent track: two soft buzzes per ring (-18 dBFS) and one chime at 6.65 s as the end card rises (-26 dBFS). If an Instagram library instrumental is added, keep it without lyrics and keep the original audio low.
Posting morning: re-read Shopify for brushed-gold-huggies (price ₹999, stock 35 on 25 Oct); never post it at 5 or fewer.

Native-reader gate: মঙ্গল needs a signed Bengali reader on the NEW cover.jpg (the seal word is now one ink). Without one, swap the seal word to मंगळ (in build.py change seal('plum', 'bn', ...) to seal('plum', 'mr', ...), re-run, re-render the cover and the reel) and the caption line to "Today's mangal: Marathi, मंगळ."
deviations: GRID PASS r3 POLISH (26 Oct, the director's optional P8 fix 1; _build/build.py RING2_R_RIGHT_MAX = 218): ring 2's RIGHT arcs end at 218. The 240 px right arc now pulses at ring 1 only (1.00 and 1.30 s), when no huggie is on screen. At ring 2 (2.80-3.45 s, radii 196/218/240) huggie A has already landed at (818, 960), and that arc came about 20 px from its left edge (the director's 3.0 s frame), so for 0.6 s the huggie looked as if it were vibrating. That is the clip-art 'ringing' read r3 removed when it deleted the huggie strokes. Ring 2 keeps 196 and 218 on the right and all three radii on the left. The buzz track (_build/sfx.sh) is unchanged: four pulses, as before. The cover never shows the arcs, so it is pixel-identical.

GRID PASS r3 (26 Oct, the grid director's remaining fixes; edited in _build/build.py). (1) The eight vibration arcs, the gold '(( ))' strokes on both sides of each huggie, are DELETED from the cover still and every reel beat (with their CSS, timings and the A-strokes undraw/redraw logic). With four headline lines, a twelve-key phone with a pixel screen, two huggies at 5x, the note and the seal they made P8 the busiest tile in the grid, and they were a clip-art 'ringing' icon; the copy and the '1 MISSED CALL' to '2 MISSED CALLS' screen carry the gag. The phone's own ring pulses (each gone within 0.3 s, never on the cover) and the buzz track stay. (2) The second headline pair 'TWO RINGS: / CALL ME BACK.' is date gold #E7C27A (7.47 on plum), not marigold: it was the grid's only orange headline, dead centre in r2c2, louder and cheaper than the gold eyebrows on every dark tile. Blush over gold still separates the pairs. (3) The end card takes the system piece line (S2), a 40 px stack: the spec line as .t-spec 20 px .16em at 1018 (was a 24 px t-label at 1024); the price as the piece line, 24 px .14em in L (blush) at 1058; '[ 18K GOLD TONE PLATED ]' alone as .t-bracket.tone 20 px at 1098 (it ran on after the price, '₹999 · [ ... ]', at 1066); the aside 1148 -> 1166. The card's Velista headline IS the name, so the piece line carries the price alone (the component's price-alone case) rather than saying BRUSHED GOLD HUGGIES twice in four lines. Five end-card lines now: the last settles at 7.57 s and holds 2.53 s.

GRID PASS r2 (26 Oct), SEAL AT +240 (system S1): a reel's grid crop is y 240-1680, so the reel seal moves from +224 to +240 and lands in exactly the stills' band inside the tile. At +224 P8's MANGAL sat 16 px above P7's and P9's in row 2, all three side by side. Now: wordmark top 1476, MANGAL baseline 1560, মঙ্গল baseline 1604, key top 1475; measured ink x 389.5-691.5, y 1476-1606.5 (the still's 1236-1366.5 + 240), 73.5 px inside the grid crop and 28.5 px inside the 4:5 crop (1635). Nothing else changes: the stage ends at y 1372, 104 px above the seal; 'shown larger.' stays on the phone scene, the second of the grid's two allowed scenes.

GRID PASS r1 (26 Oct). SEAL: the new REEL seal from _system/_build/seal.py in build.py (plum, মঙ্গল one copy in blush at 32 px, MANGAL 64 in blush with a 2 px marigold plate, wordmark-cream-blush at 120 px, chaabi-seal-plum at 130 px, everything +224: wordmark top 1460, MANGAL baseline 1544, script 1588, key top 1459). It is in every state where the seal shows (frame 0 to the end; it never moves). Measured on the cover: ink x 389.5-691.5, y 1460-1590.5 (302 x 130.5, centre x 540.5).

GRID PASS r1. 'shown larger.' is KEPT on the phone scene (the cover, and the reel from 4.0 s until the glide): one of the grid's two allowed scenes, the 12 mm huggies about 5x against the drawn keypad phone. It is DELETED from the end card (huggies at 270 px on plain plum, no drawn object), so the end card is four lines.

GRID PASS r1 (the director's optional polish): the vibration strokes about each huggie are cut from three to two a side (radii 130 and 150), so they read as ringing, not a cartoon buzz. The phone's own ring arcs (which pulse and are off in the cover state) are unchanged.

CUT-OUT SOURCE. The spec's cutouts/brushed-gold-huggies/00-trim.png holds the pair at 370x227 (each huggie about 185 px), and its suggested x00 re-cut comes from the same 896 px listing image, so 210 and 230 px would upscale. Both huggies are cut instead from the listing's own 2048 px scale photo (image 3, 'beside a cardamom pod for scale') with a full-resolution BiRefNet matte: each huggie is 525 px of ink, shown at 216 px on the cover and 270 px on the end card. The cardamom pod was removed by hue. About 12 px of the right huggie's rim that the pod hid was grafted from the left huggie of the same photo (same piece, same light; the two rim profiles agree within 1-2 px on the clean rows). New files: cutouts/brushed-gold-huggies/s03-left-trim.png and s03-right-trim.png, added to cutouts/index.json and README.

LCD DOT MATRIX. At the spec's 5 px dots on a 6 px pitch, '2 MISSED' is 282 px wide, wider than the 270-290 px screen. It is set in 4 px dots on a 5 px pitch with a 3-column space (225 px), centred. The spec's glyph bitmaps are used unchanged.

PHONE DRAWING. Body 340x520 (spec 360x500), radius 44, still rotated -6 degrees, centred at (440,1102) (spec (540,1110)) so the stage sits nearer the centre and the huggies' strokes clear the phone. It adds an earpiece slot, signal bars, a battery and a nav row (navi key and two soft keys) between screen and keypad so it reads as a 2006 candybar at grid size. Still three fills (#8EA9A1 body, #AFBFA9 screen, #D9DDDC keys) and one ink. The ink is plum #2E2338 (the system's rule: D-ink or plum) instead of #1A1614 at 80%: same weight, and it belongs to the palette.
HUGGIE POSITIONS. A at (818,960) and B at (822,1222), 216 px of ink each (spec (850,950), (830,1200), 210 px), moved with the phone.

(Grid pass r1: two strokes a side about each huggie, 130 and 150 px, not three.) VIBRATION STROKES. The spec's radii 70/90/110 fall inside a 210 px huggie (half-width 105). They are 130/150/170 px at ±24 degrees about each huggie's centre, so they clear the piece. The phone's ring arcs are 196/218/240 px at ±16 degrees about the phone's centre. They never share the screen with a huggie's strokes: A's strokes are off for ring 2 (see RING 2 BELONGS TO THE PHONE).

'shown larger.' on the cover is centred under huggie B at x 822, baseline 1364 (spec x 770, baseline 1330, which sat in B's contact shadow). In the video it fades in as huggie B lands (4.0 s), not when A lands: from 2.1 s it labelled B's empty slot for about 1.8 s. So the 2.4 s key frame no longer shows it; 'shown larger.' is removed from that key frame's copy and build line in briefs/option-b.json (slide 2). The cover is unchanged.

WORDS AT x 72, not x 60. The spec puts the eyebrow and headline at x 60 (the system's house-rule position), but in-video words must stay inside x 72-1008. Ink now starts at x 74. That is 4 px at grid scale.

TRANSITION. A 900 px drop would carry the phone through the seal band for most of its travel (seen in a test render at 6.0-6.2 s). The phone instead sinks 18 px and fades over 0.5 s from 5.6 s (36 px until this pass, see PHONE EXIT). Words fade over 0.45-0.5 s from 5.6 s. The push-in runs 4.3-5.8 s (1.00 to 1.02) and eases back to 1.00 during A's glide, so the end positions are exact. The second headline pair types up from 3.55 s (spec 3.6) so 'CALL ME BACK.' holds 1.2 s.

(Grid pass r1: the end card's 'shown larger.' at 852 is deleted; the text is now 962 / 1024 / 1066 / 1148 and the last line settles at 7.49 s, held 2.61 s.) END CARD. At the spec's 230 px wide on centres 430/650, the huggies would overlap by 10 px. The pair is 270 px each with a 30 px gap, centred on x 540 at y 680 (spec 760). Text baselines are 852 / 962 / 1024 / 1066 / 1148 (spec 880 / 1000 / 1060 / 1102 / 1170), so the group centres between the top safe line and the seal. The five lines rise from 6.65 s on a 0.08 s stagger (spec 6.3 s, 0.12 s) and the last settles at 7.57 s.

RING PULSES. Each ring is two 0.3 s arc pulses (ring 1 at 0.90 and 1.20 s, ring 2 at 2.80 and 3.10 s), staggered 0.05 s per radius. Ring 1 therefore ends at 1.6 s, not 1.4 s. The screen still switches at 1.4 s and 3.4 s, as specified.

COVER EXPORTS. tools/export.py assumes a 3:4 still, so _build/export_cover.py writes cover.jpg (1080x1920), cover-grid.jpg (y 240-1680), cover-45.jpg (y 285-1635) and cover-thumb.png (391x521 from the grid crop).

GLIDE ORDER (AD fix 3). Both huggies used to glide together from 5.8 s, and B, ending LEFT, crossed A, ending RIGHT: at 6.15-6.25 s the two merged into one gold lump. The AD's first option (A from 5.80 s, B from 6.00 s, slots unchanged) was built and measured with the alpha bounding boxes of both cut-outs at every 1/30 s frame: it still intersects at 6.40-6.50 s (up to 57 px), because B's straight path to the left slot passes under A's slot after A has arrived. The AD's alternative is used: the end slots are swapped (A, ring 1, ends LEFT; B, ring 2, ends RIGHT) and the stagger is kept (A 5.80-6.50 s, B 6.00-6.70 s). Measured at all 31 frames from 5.8 to 6.8 s: no intersection, minimum separation 30 px (the final gap). The pair now reads left to right as first ring, second ring. Each piece keeps its own cut-out, so the end card shows the right-hand cut-out on the left; both share one light and one orientation, so the pair still reads as a pair (checked at full size).

DURATION 10.1 s, not 10.0 s (AD fix 1). The AD's rule is T - (END_T + 4 x END_STAG + 0.6) >= 2.5 s, to be redone after fix 3 moved END_T to 6.65 s. With END_STAG 0.08 the last line settles at 7.57 s, so T = 10.0 gives a 2.43 s hold; T = 10.1 gives 2.53 s. Frame-diff of the rendered video confirms it: the last change above 6 grey levels in the text band is at 7.57 s, then 2.53 s static to the loop.
CHIME at 6.65 s, not 6.45 s, so it still sounds as the end card rises (END_T moved). sfx.wav is generated at 10.1 s.

GLINT (AD fix 2). The kit glint (a .85-.95 white band over about 60% of the piece) washed the satin piece to cream and read as mirror polish. A P8-only override narrows it to a warm .30-.40 sheen (the AD's gradient). It now sweeps huggie B, which ends on the right, still at 7.2 s (visible on the piece 7.8-8.0 s). Measured on the masked piece in every frame 7.0-9.0 s: mean blue rises at most 6.5 levels (limit 15), red 3.3, green 5.1.

DROP-IN (AD fix 4). The huggies use a P8-local drop-in-solid (opaque from 18% of 0.8 s, same travel, rotation and --ease-drop), not the kit drop-in, which is half transparent until 60% and showed each huggie as a grey-brown ghost over plum at 1.55 and 3.55 s. Huggie B now has its own drop-in-solid-b (see B'S DROP).

FRAME 0 (AD fix 6). Eyebrow and seal no longer fade in, and the phone settles 18 px to 0 at full opacity (46 px until this pass, see FRAME 0 CLEARANCE) (settle-in, 0.9 s, --ease-out) instead of rising in from opacity 0, so the frame Reels and Feed autoplay open on already shows phone, eyebrow and seal. Nothing else in the timeline moved.

END CARD SPEC LINE (AD fix 7). 'ABOUT 12MM ACROSS · A 6MM BAND · BRUSHED SATIN' is now 'ONE PAIR OF EARRINGS · ABOUT 12MM ACROSS · A 6MM BAND': the front-view cut-outs read as cushions or finger rings, the headline says TWO RINGS, and 'Huggies' is also a nappy brand. Measured in Jost 400 24 px at .14em: 869 px of ink, x 105-975, centred on 540, so '· A 6MM BAND' stays. 'Brushed' is still on screen in the product name. The caption now says 'huggie earrings' (post.json and briefs/option-b.json); the alt text names one pair of earrings. briefs/option-b.json now carries it in slide 4's build and copy (see BRIEF).

SUPERSEDED (grid pass r1, the seal was rebuilt): SEAL. _system/system.css changed after the last P8 render: on plum, MANGAL's keyline and the script's keyline are now the ground colour, and the script is a blush front on a marigold back (_system README deviations 9 and 10). P8 links the system and redraws nothing, so the cover and reel carry the current system seal. Diffed against the previous cover: the only changed pixels are the seal words (x 363-716, y 1468-1607); everything else is identical.

RING 2 BELONGS TO THE PHONE (AD fix pass 3, item 1). The phone's ring-2 arcs (x 620-690, y 1015-1130) landed just under huggie A's left strokes and read as one broken column of six arcs. A's stroke group now fades out from 2.70 s (0.10 s, --ease-in), so it is gone at 2.80 s when ring 2 starts. A's strokes are drawn again at 3.90 s together with B's (draw 0.35 s, same 0.06 s stagger), and from then on the pair rings as one. An 'undraw' hold keeps each of A's arcs at zero length from 2.80 s until its own redraw. Without it, the middle and outer arcs flashed back at full length for 60-120 ms at 3.90 s: seen on the first render of this fix, then fixed and checked per frame. The cover/still state is unchanged.

B'S DROP (AD fix pass 3, item 2). Huggie B uses its own drop-in-solid-b: from opacity 0, translateY(-60px) and rotate(-6deg); opaque at 8%; to none; still 0.8 s with --ease-drop from 3.50 s. A keeps -120 px and 18%.
FRAME 0 CLEARANCE (AD fix pass 3, item 3). settle-in starts at translateY(18px), not 46px, still 0.9 s with --ease-out.

PHONE EXIT, 18 px instead of 36 px. This was not asked for, but it follows from item 3's rule that the phone's lowest ink stays at least 35 px above the wordmark on every frame. With the 36 px sink, the fading phone (opacity 0.44 and 0.24) came within 30 and 23 px of the wordmark at 6.03 and 6.07 s. At 18 px, the exit now mirrors the entrance and the gap is at least 37 px on every visible frame. The timing is unchanged (0.5 s, --ease-in, from 5.6 s).

BRIEF (AD fix pass 3, item 4). briefs/option-b.json, P8, now carries the shipped values. Slide 4's build and copy have END_T 6.65 s on a 0.08 s stagger to the 10.1 s loop, the pair at 270 px each centred at y 680 with A left at (390,680) and B right at (690,680), the baselines 852/962/1024/1066/1148 and 'ONE PAIR OF EARRINGS · ABOUT 12MM ACROSS · A 6MM BAND'. The motion block is rewritten as the shipped 10.1 s shot list, including this pass's stroke, drop, settle and exit changes and the chime at 6.65 s. The alt_text is this post.json's. In the system rhythm map, 'P8 ... REEL 9 s' and '3 reels (P8 9 s, ...)' now read 10.1 s, with the columns kept aligned. Slide 3's push-in scale at 4.8 s is now 1.007, not 1.015, because 4.8 s falls a third of the way through the 4.3-5.8 s push. Slide 1's build still gives the spec's original cover coordinates; the shipped differences are listed in the deviations above. Verified: no other post and no other system key changed.

Price and stock: brushed-gold-huggies ₹999 (compareAt not shown), stock 35, ACTIVE, not pre-order, variant Default (one pair). Re-read in research/roster.json on 26 Oct (file of 25 Oct): unchanged. The price appears only on the end card and in the caption, never on the cover.

Claims: '[ 18K GOLD TONE PLATED ]' and the tag '18k Gold Tone Plated' are present. 'One pair of earrings' is the product itself (one pair per order). 'About 12mm across', 'a 6mm band' (listing: 'wide flat band, approximately 6mm deep'), 'brushed satin' and 'chunky without the weight' come from the listing. Waterproof, tarnish-free, hypoallergenic and any material claim are not used. 'Gold' appears only in the product's own name, beside the tone bracket. Never-list: no em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji, codes, percentages, struck MRPs, urgency, order-by dates, phone brand or ringtone. 'Manglik' is not used.

Colours, all from the system: ground #3B2D4A; inks blush #F2CFC4, marigold #E8973A (second headline pair and the seal's second ink), date gold #E7C27A (eyebrow and strokes), plum ink #2E2338; object colours #8EA9A1, #AFBFA9, #D9DDDC, with an LCD line in sage deep #3F5A4C.

(Grid pass r1: the seal's ink now ends at y 1590.5, 89.5 px inside the grid crop and 44.5 px inside the 4:5 crop.) Cover safe areas (measured ink): top-right x 907-1080 / y 240-442 is empty. NATIVE-READER GATE RESET (grid pass r1): মঙ্গল is now one blush copy at 32 px, so any earlier sign-off is void; a native Bengali reader must sign the NEW cover.jpg. Script: মঙ্গল rendered in Chromium and checked at 4x on the final cover PNG (_work/fix3-frames/script-4x.png): ম, the stacked ঙ্গ conjunct, ল and an unbroken matra. It matches the spec's string. A native Bengali reader's sign-off is still required before posting.

Motion (frames viewed from the final mp4 at 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.2, 1.67, 2.4, 2.73, 2.77, 2.8, 2.93, 3.13, 3.23, 3.5, 3.53, 3.57, 3.6, 3.63, 3.67, 3.7, 3.9, 4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.8, 5.6, 6.0, 6.27, 6.5, 6.9, 7.5, 8.5 and 10.07 s): frame 0 shows phone, eyebrow and seal with clear air above the wordmark. The phone never shakes; there is one hero move per beat and one overshoot (the drops). At 2.4 s the frame shows 1 MISSED / CALL with huggie A and all its strokes, no B and no note. At 2.93-3.23 s, ring 2 shows only the phone's arcs beside a clean huggie A. From 3.9 s both huggies draw their strokes in step. At 4.8 s the frame matches the cover with the stage pushed in about 0.7%. Words hold at least 1.2 s.

End card hold: the five lines rise from 6.65 s (0.08 s stagger) and the last settles at 7.57 s; frame-diff of the text band shows no change above 6 grey levels after 7.57 s, so the complete card, price included, holds 2.53 s before the loop (rule 2.5 s). The glint (7.8-8.0 s on the piece) is the only movement in the hold.
Audio: AAC 48 kHz stereo, 10.1 s. The buzz peaks at -18.0 dBFS, the chime at -25.9 dBFS from 6.65 s, and the track is silent before 0.9 s.

RING 2 (fix 1), per frame in Chromium at reel.cjs times.
